topics.title: Greedy
topics.summary: Take the best step now and never look back

guide.title: Simple choices, fast programs
points: A greedy solution picks the best option at each step.
It is correct only when a local best always leads to a global best.

problems.title: Largest pair sum
problems.statement: Return the largest sum of two different elements of the array. The array has at least two numbers.
problems.hint: You only need the two largest values.
